senses.gloss:
गोचर गो-चर, m.
 1. Pasture ground; in अद्भुत-, adj. Having excellent pasture ground, Rām. 4, 44, 80.
 2. Stay, abode; used only as latter part of comp. adj., e. g. वन-, Inhabiting woods, Man. 8, 259; आकाश-, Moving in the air, Rām. 5, 3, 35. शरीरान्तर-, Being in the body, Rām. 6, 101, 30; यौवन-, Being in one's youth, MBh. 1, 3168.
 3. Reach, province; हर्तुर् याति न गोचरम्, Comes not within the reach of a robber, i. e. cannot be robbed, Bhartṛ. 2, 49; वाण-, m. The reach of an arrow-shot, MBh. 1, 2833; अ-वाङ्-मनस-, adj. Within the reach neither of speech nor thought, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 3.
 4. The range of the eyes, MBh. 7, 5616.
 5. An object of sense, as sound, shape, etc., Bhag. 13, 5.
 6. An object of devotion, MBh. 13, 4349.
 --Comp.
गो- + चर्मन् गो- + चर्मन्, n. the hide of a cow, MBh. 13, 1228.
